title.zh: 设置存储空间的版本控制状态
title.en: Set the versioning state of a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 要配置版本控制，您必须有PutBucketVersioning权限。

- Bucket包括未开启、开启（Enabled）或者暂停（Suspended）三种版本控制状态。默认情况下Bucket处于未开启版本控制状态。

- 在Bucket处于开启版本控制状态下，所有新添加的文件（Object）都将拥有唯一的版本ID，OSS将累积所添加Object的多个版本。

- 在Bucket处于暂停版本控制状态下，所有新添加Object的版本ID将为null，且OSS将不再为此状态下添加的Object累积更多的版本。

关于版本控制的更多信息，请参见[版本控制介绍](~~109695~~)。
descriptions.en:
- To configure versioning, you must have the PutBucketVersioning permission.

- A bucket can be in one of three versioning states: unversioned, Enabled, or Suspended. By default, a bucket is in the unversioned state.

- When a bucket is in the Enabled versioning state, all newly added objects have a unique version ID, and Object Storage Service (OSS) accumulates multiple versions of the added objects.

- When a bucket is in the Suspended versioning state, all newly added objects have a version ID of null, and OSS no longer accumulates more versions for objects added in this state.

For more information about versioning, see [Versioning overview](~~109695~~).
